queries.name: case-pathology
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND (histopathology OR biopsy OR cytology OR "bone marrow" OR curettage)

queries.name: case-imaging
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND ("computed tomography" OR MRI OR radiograph OR ultrasound)

queries.name: case-cardiology
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND (cardiology OR cardiac OR myocardial OR arrhythmia)

queries.name: case-pulmonology
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND (pulmonary OR lung OR respiratory)

queries.name: case-neurology
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND (neurology OR neurological OR seizure OR stroke)

queries.name: case-oncology
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND (carcinoma OR tumor OR lymphoma OR oncology)

queries.name: case-gastro
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND (gastrointestinal OR colon OR gastric OR hepatic OR pancreatic)

queries.name: case-endocrine
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND (diabetes OR thyroid OR endocrine OR adrenal)

queries.name: case-nephrology
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND (renal OR kidney OR nephrotic OR dialysis)

queries.name: case-pediatrics
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND (infant OR child OR pediatric OR neonatal)

queries.name: case-emergency
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND ("emergency department" OR "intensive care" OR trauma OR sepsis)

queries.name: case-psychiatry
queries.query: PUB_TYPE:"Case Reports" AND (psychiatric OR depression OR schizophrenia OR bipolar)

queries.name: education
queries.query: ("teaching case" OR "educational case" OR "clinical vignette" OR "case-based learning" OR "clinical challenge")
